info.title: Halo API
info.description: Halo discovers music metadata via the YouTube Data API and hands playback off to an external browser. It never streams, downloads or modifies YouTube content.

post.summary: Create an anonymous Halo account and return a bearer token

get.description: Machine-readable export of everything Halo stores about the user.

schema.title: Response Export Data Api V1 Me Export Get

delete.description: Permanently delete the account and all user-owned data (cascade).

get.summary: Suggestions from the user's own Halo search history plus curated seeds
Most popular music videos in the configured region (official YouTube chart)

schema.title: Response Get Search History Api V1 History Search Get

post.summary: Plan and assemble an editable playlist draft from verified search results

get.summary: Songs to choose next after a song (co-listening, same and similar artists)
Canonical recording, album, release date, label, ISRC and genres (MusicBrainz)
New and recent releases with listen counts (ListenBrainz)

schema.title: Response Fresh Releases Api V1 Discover Fresh Releases Get

get.summary: Most-listened recordings across ListenBrainz for a time range

schema.title: Response Most Listened Api V1 Discover Most Listened Get

get.summary: Live internet radio stations from the Radio Browser community directory

schema.title: Response Radio Stations Api V1 Radio Stations Get

Attribution.title: Attribution
Attribution.description: Source attribution that clients must display next to provider metadata.

CanonicalRecording.title: CanonicalRecording
CanonicalRecording.description: What a song really is, according to MusicBrainz.

basis.title: Basis
basis.default: Inferred from your activity inside Halo: saved songs, playlists, searches and feedback. Halo cannot see what you play in Brave or on YouTube.

TasteProfile.title: TasteProfile
TasteProfile.description:
Inferred from Halo activity only (saves, playlists, searches, feedback).

This is not playback history: Halo cannot see what was played in Brave.

TrackMetadataResponse.title: TrackMetadataResponse
TrackMetadataResponse.description: Canonical facts about a YouTube song from MusicBrainz (CC0 data).

UpNextResponse.title: UpNextResponse
UpNextResponse.description: Songs to pick next after a handoff. The listener chooses; nothing auto-plays.
